items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey DNP second straight day with rib injury, making him unlikely available vs Raiders Sunday.
items.implication: Plan to sit; boosts other Chargers WRs.
items.opportunity: Elevated snaps/routes/targets for Quentin Johnston and Tre Harris.

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) DNP second straight practice. Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) on IR. If Flowers out, Ravens WR hierarchy: Bateman, Devontez Walker, Wester, Sarratt, Moore.
items.implication: Uncertain for Saints; Bateman flex candidate.

items.text: Nico Collins hurt hamstring in Wednesday practice (history of missing 5 games in 2024); DNP Thursday after Grade 1 strain diagnosis. Ran 37 of 42 routes in W1. MRI/status key; availability for Bengals in jeopardy.
items.why: Hamstring grab in practice + prior soft-tissue history; Grade 1 lowest severity but DNP on key day.
items.implication: Sit or have backup plan; short-term absence possible 1-3 games.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson says ready to go after ankle; full participant. Unclear how much he earns vs Rhamondre Stevenson, but timing excellent with AJ Brown on IR and strong upcoming matchups (PIT/JAX/BUF etc before bye).
items.why: Full practice + self-report; Pats need explosives post-Brown IR.
items.opportunity: Explosive carries/routes possible in committee; goal-line TBD.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers DNP again Thursday due to last week’s knee surgery; has yet to practice since procedure.
items.why: No practice post-surgery; day-to-day framing elsewhere.
items.implication: Low chance for W2; monitor for W3 return.
items.opportunity: TE targets to other Raiders if OUT.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow limited participant second consecutive day due to back injury.
items.implication: Monitor Friday; could affect Chase/Higgins/Brown if limited mobility.

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE: 24% target share (team lead/tie) and high snaps/touches in Chiefs debut; RB1 overall in range of outcomes if healthy. Smash vs IND who just gave up big to Henry.
items.why: 24% tgt share, 74% snaps early, elite utilization; matchup.

items.text: W2 waiver injury beneficiaries precise: Ladd McConkey=Tre Harris; Ja'Kobi Lane=Rashod Bateman/Chris Moore; AJ Brown=Romeo Doubs/DeMario Douglas; De'Zhaun Stribling=Deebo Samuel; Alvin Kamara=Kendre Miller (reverse). Deebo Samuel strong waiver.
items.why: Direct injury replacements with role upside.

items.text: DeVonta Smith LOVE (bounceback): 27% target share + 13.7 aDOT with deep looks in W1. Tough W1 but back in; TEN soft vs WRs.
Ashton Jeanty LOVE: Utilization Score 99 in W1 (tied Bijan lead); high target share history and 25+ touches recent. Overreaction to prior injury scare.
items.why: Elite util 99 under Kubiak; consistent touches/targets.

items.text: Bucky Irving LOVE: Career-high 26% target share, out-routed Gainwell by 8, all RB red-zone touches in W1. Good matchup vs CLE run D.
Travis Etienne HATE: Matched Kendre Miller rushes in W1; most points via air. Kamara expected back squeezes role further; bad script as underdogs @ BAL.
items.implication: Sit/flex down; Miller beneficiary if Kamara limited.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr. HATE: Only 8% target share W1 (5th on team), zero RZ. SEA tough vs WRs.
Dalton Kincaid LOVE: 69% route participation (higher than any 2025 game), 77% snaps; efficient TE with DET soft vs TEs.
